crossRefs.note: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and don’t tell the truth.
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen…
What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
They cry to me, ‘My God, we Israel acknowledge you!’
Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.
They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any…
If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and don’t tell the truth.
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

translations.web: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
translations.bsb: If anyone says, “I know Him,” but does not keep His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
translations.kjv: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
translations.asv: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him;
